record.question: The source of impurities in pharmaceuticals is most commonly from:
options: The colouring agents of the drug
The preservatives that are added to the drug
Contaminated raw materials & improper manufacturing process
Using the drug beyond its expiry date
record.explanation: Answer C: Contaminated raw materials & improper manufacturing process. Impurities commonly arise from contaminated raw materials, manufacturing processes, equipment, or inadequate controls. Reference: https://www.fda.gov/drugs/pharmaceutical-quality-resources/quality-considerations-artificial-intelligence-drug-manufacturing. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
